reasons.A: Long, smoothly joined sentences with semicolons and explanatory clauses; a measured how-to register far from the author's clipped, plain declaratives.
reasons.B: Gets the short sentences and fragments, but leans into a relentless imperative manual voice and stacks fragments more thickly than the passage, tipping into caricature.
reasons.C: Closest mix of short declaratives, fragments, imperatives and plain first-person asides ('I do not do it now'), no contractions, with rhythm that varies like the passage; only a slightly showy close.
